requirements.quote: All information provided herein is true and correct to the best of their knowledge.
requirements.text: The bidder must certify the truth and correctness of the provided information.

requirements.quote: The respondent has read and understands the specifications in their entirety and that the response is made in accordance therewith, and;
requirements.text: The bidder must confirm understanding and compliance with the specifications.

requirements.quote: The respondent possesses the capabilities, resources, and personnel necessary to provide efficient and successful service to the Authority, and;
requirements.text: The bidder must confirm they have the necessary capabilities, resources, and personnel.

requirements.quote: The respondent agrees to all terms and conditions as provided within the specifications.
requirements.text: The bidder must agree to all terms and conditions in the specifications.
